title: Root-dictionary writer scratch last-use release
scope: Release fileExport root-dictionary setup collections after their actual last use.
Preserve root-entry validation, handle remapping, and Background suppression behavior.
Verify with the focused writer build and owning root/object graph CTests.

changes: Capture whether backgroundRootEntries was nonempty, consume its entries into rootEntries, then release the vector and its string storage before the named-object dictionary scan; the later filter uses only the captured presence flag.
Release rootEntryNames nodes, keys, and buckets after its final duplicate-name check in the named-object dictionary scan, before layout-root insertion and writer handoff.
Keep rootEntries, material dictionaries, source dictionaries, object-graph validation, and serialization inputs intact.

method.kind: Source-level last-use audit plus focused build/CTest verification
method.limitations: The owning tests verify emitted root/object behavior but do not benchmark peak memory. The change only proves early release at the audited last-use boundaries; it does not close the wider 7S.2c retained-output/callback ownership census.
